metadata.name: The Binding Of Isaac - Ascention
metadata.description: Play as Geburah with golden tears, the Eye of the Sun and her Empress's Tiara guardians. Adds Arclight and Golden Eye, plus a Revelation rework and custom Mini Isaac combat. Requires Repentance+, REPENTOGON and Windows. IMPORTANT: Workshop cannot distribute the required native module. Download Ascention Native Setup from https://github.com/WhiteRave-Official/the_binding_of_isaac_ascention/releases and run it after subscribing and after each mod update. The installer checks REPENTOGON compatibility before installing.
